text.card: A red giant 2,242 parsecs away, 24 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.31 solar masses and 23.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,327 K at its surface.
